rule.text: Figures are rounded with the largest-remainder method so each row adds up exactly. Age brackets come directly from the PSA 2024 Census; workforce and education combine PSA Labor Force Survey baselines with Provincial Product Accounts industry mix. Commute and nativity are null where PSA does not publish city-level tables. A specialist is ≥ 1.5× or ≤ 0.67× the national share.
